stewardshipDecisions.kimiReviewSummary: Kimi accepted the listed load-path, coordination, and drainage mechanism relationships as useful non-destructive ACS graph enrichment. Kimi deferred/rejected over-strong or context-sensitive candidates including base-plate TRANSFERS_LOAD_TO footing, diaphragm opening CONSTRAINS diaphragm action, seismic load CONSTRAINS diaphragm action, site drainage planning COORDINATES_WITH surface runoff, storm sewer pipe DISCHARGES_TO detention/retention, overland overflow DISCHARGES_TO culvert interface, soil infiltration rate CONSTRAINS bioretention cell, pavement/subgrade abstract coordination, topography CONSTRAINS FFE, DFE/FFE coordination, and emergency access geometry/pavement-structure abstract coordination. Accepted replacement candidates 037/038 are coordination-only and non-numerical.
